reader.requirement: At --std 85 the EXTERNAL clause on a data description entry must be refused unless the entry is level 01 in the Working-Storage Section: refused at levels 02-49 and 77, and in the File, Linkage and Communication Sections; admitted on 01 in Working-Storage, where the record is shared across the run unit.

The one row term a later edition adds, TypeDeclarationInAnySection (EXTERNAL on a level 1 TYPEDEF anywhere), is unreachable at 85 because VersionConformancePass refuses TYPEDEF below 2002 (probe x2td.cob).

reader.notes: One residence row (Sections = WorkingStorage, level 1) refuses each misplaced EXTERNAL with COBOL2404 and drops the clause, so a refused EXTERNAL never reaches CallBindExternalAndGlobal. The FD-level EXTERNAL is a separate clause (fileGlobalExternalClause), untouched by this row.
